extracted.name: Apple Baked Beans
extracted.description: Combine apples, crispy bacon, and raisins to canned pork and beans to bake a tasty new version of baked beans everyone will love!
ingredient_lines: 2 Granny Smith apples - peeled, cored, and diced
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Stir pork and beans, bacon, apples, barbeque sauce, brown sugar, and raisins together in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake in preheated oven for 90 minutes.
